checks.name: All titles, sources and passages stay inside encryption
Wrong-key access fails with a generic refusal
Ciphertext tamper produces the same generic refusal
Independent encryptions use fresh salt and IV
Lowered KDF, different cipher and extra envelope fields refuse
Short PIN and trivial repetitive passwords refuse
Psychology and Sikh corpora cannot be hidden in this restricted payload
Unbounded, duplicate, invalid-source and unrecorded-license payloads refuse
CLI-compatible pack operation only writes an encrypted output
Packing refuses to overwrite an existing encrypted output
Regular repositories, worktrees and symlink targets are all excluded
GIT_WORK_TREE environment override cannot disguise a repository input
Invalid private JSON does not appear in diagnostics
No password command-line option exists or echoes its value
HTML pins the sole closed runtime executable

limits: Synthetic builder tests; not Claude review or real-device acceptance.
No real user data or real password is exercised.
